title: Mapping Two Decades of Extradition-Related Publications: A Scopus-Based Bibliometric Analysis
core_idea: Address the gap in systematic mapping of extradition scholarship by conducting a bibliometric analysis of publications from 2004–2024 using a Scopus-derived dataset (837 documents) and tools including Scopus analysis, Harzing's Publish or Perish, and VOSviewer within a four-step bibliometric methodology and the PRISMA framework to reveal publication trends, leading contributors, citation patterns, and thematic development.
tldr: A study that systematically maps extradition-related scholarship (2004–2024) via a Scopus-based bibliometric approach to characterize publication trends, contributors, citation metrics, and thematic evolution using established bibliometric tools and PRISMA.
